list.intro: Landing pages live at their own address and are built from blocks in Romanian and English. The owner, admins, moderators and anyone whose role includes Landing pages can make and publish them.
list.addressHint: The page will be at {{site}}/c/ and this name: lowercase letters, numbers and hyphens.
list.heading: Landing pages
list.empty: There are no landing pages yet.

failures.bad_address: Use 2 to 60 lowercase letters, numbers and hyphens, starting with a letter or number.
failures.reserved: That name is reserved. Pick another.
failures.taken: Another page already uses that address.
failures.not_allowed: Only the owner and admins can make landing pages.
failures.unreachable: We couldn’t reach the server. Try again.
failures.bad_layout: Pick a layout from the list.
failures.too_big: This page is too big to save. Remove some blocks or shorten the text.

editor.heading: /c/{{slug}} ({{type}})
editor.blocksHint: Every block is edited the same way: press Edit on a block and its fields open beside this list.
editor.full: A page holds at most {{most}} blocks.
editor.linkHint: One of our own pages, such as /help/contest-rules, or an address starting with https://.
editor.datesHint: The page goes live at 00:00 Romanian time on the “show from” date. From the take-down date it stays at its address and says it has ended.

problems.count: a page needs between 2 and 30 blocks
problems.unequal: add at least one question, with the same number in both languages
problems.hero_first: the page needs one Hero block, at the top
problems.contest_needs_dates_and_rules: a contest page needs a Key dates block and a Rules block
problems.unknown_kind: this block can’t be used; remove it
problems.out_of_order: the dates must go entries open, entries close, results
problems.bad_link: use one of our pages or an https:// address
problems.before_show_from: the take-down date must come after the “show from” date
problems.dates_bad_date: One of the dates isn’t valid.
problems.dates_out_of_order: Entries open, then close, then the results come out.
problems.link_empty: Add the address it links to.
problems.link_bad_link: Use one of our pages or an https:// address.
problems.age_groups: Pick at least one age group.
problems.items: Add at least one question, in both languages.
problems.not_allowed: only a Hero, Text or Picture and text block can have a picture
problems.picture_not_checked: The picture isn’t checked yet. Publish once the check passes.
problems.picture_unknown: This picture no longer exists. Upload it again.
problems.picture_not_allowed: Only a Hero, Text or Picture and text block can have a picture.
problems.stories_unknown: One of these addresses isn’t a story. Check each line.
problems.tag_unknown: There is no tag with that name.
problems.one_remind_me: a page can have one Remind me block
problems.remind_me_needs_dates: a Remind me block needs a Key dates block on the page
problems.wrong_number: the number of cards or steps is outside the limits, or differs between languages

failures.take_down_before_show_from: The take-down date must come after the “show from” date.
failures.not_allowed: Building landing pages isn’t part of your staff role.
failures.not_found: This page or version no longer exists. Reload and try again.

failures.too_big: This page is too big to save. Remove some blocks or shorten the text.

outcomes.save: Draft saved. Nothing has changed on the page yet.
outcomes.publish: Published. The page shows this version from {{date}}.
outcomes.restore: That version is now the draft. Publish it to put it back on the page.

editor.archiveQuestion: Archive /c/{{slug}}? The address stops working for good.
editor.archived: This page is archived. Its address no longer works.

picture.label: Picture (optional)
picture.hint: A picture: JPEG, PNG or WebP, up to 5 MB. It is checked before the page can be published.
picture.altHint: Say what the picture shows, for people who can’t see it.

featured.storiesHint: One per line, for example /s/the-name-of-the-story. At most {{most}}.
featured.filterNote: Visitors see only stories rated for the youngest readers in Who can enter (13 to 15 when the page has no such block), and a story hidden by moderation drops off at once.

cards.howMany: Add between {{fewest}} and {{most}} cards, the same in both languages.

steps.howMany: Add between {{fewest}} and {{most}} steps, the same in both languages.

search.intro: What search engines and share cards show, in each language. An empty field uses the hero's title and introduction.
search.title: Search title
search.hidden: Hide this page from search engines
search.hiddenHint: Visitors can still open it from a link.

states.waiting_for_person: Picture waiting for a moderator to approve it.
states.removed: Picture removed by the moderation team.

featured.previewNote: The stories appear here once the page is published: only stories rated for the youngest readers the page is for.

remindMe.offer: Entries open on {{date}}. We’ll send you one notification that day, nothing else.
remindMe.isSet: We’ll remind you on {{date}}, with one notification.
remindMe.signIn: Entries open on {{date}}. Log in and we’ll remind you that day.
remindMe.failed: We couldn’t save that. Try again.
remindMe.previewNote: Signed-in readers can ask here for one notification on the day entries open.

kindHints.hero: The page title, a short introduction and a picture, at the top.
kindHints.text: A heading and paragraphs, with an optional picture.
kindHints.picture_text: A picture beside a heading and paragraphs.
kindHints.quote: A short quote and who said it.
kindHints.cards: Two to four cards side by side, each with a title and a few words.
kindHints.steps: Two to six numbered steps, each with a title and a few words.
kindHints.questions: Questions that open to show their answers.
kindHints.key_dates: When entries open, when they close and when the results come out.
kindHints.who_can_enter: The age groups that can enter.
kindHints.rules: A short summary with a link to the full rules.
kindHints.featured: Up to 12 stories, picked by hand or by tag.
kindHints.call_to_action: A heading, a line of text and one button.
kindHints.remind_me: Lets readers ask for a reminder before entries close.
